name: The studio
rule: Anyone can draw a random rat in the browser for free: a procedural generator, no AI, nothing to pay. The studio draws rats, the depot's other residents, so nothing made there can be taken for a cat out of a box. Drawing a rat from a prompt goes through paid AI services, so it is sold in packs bought on-chain in plain USDC before anything is generated. A sketch is one cartoon picture of the rat from the prompt; a model turns one of the account's sketches into a 3D mesh. The backend spends one unit before it calls the service and gives it back if the service fails.

sketch.name: Sketch
sketch.rule: One cartoon picture from a prompt, in the house style. Cheap: try again until the rat looks right.

model.name: 3D model
model.rule: One of the account's sketches turned into a 3D mesh (GLB), drawn in the browser with the game's toon materials.

marginRule: Every pack sells for at least minMargin times what its units are estimated to cost the collection: the services are paid back, and the rest goes to the treasury.

prompt.style: A single funny cartoon rat character, {prompt}. Full body, three-quarter front view, centered, floating alone on a plain pure white background, no shadow under the feet, no floor, nothing else in the picture. Big round ears, long pointed snout, two buck teeth, long pink tail. Thick dark outlines, flat bold colours, soft rounded chunky shapes, toy-like proportions with a big head. No text, no logo, no other characters.
prompt.rule: The player's words go inside a fixed style prompt, so whatever is asked the result stays a cartoon rat in the game's style. Prompts naming a licensed character or asking for adult content are refused before any service is called.

PackBought.note: StudioPacks. Credits the account with the pack's units; the backend counts what is spent.

rats.name: The depot's rats
rats.rule: A rat drawn in the studio can be adopted: minted as an ERC-721 in the Rats contract, paid in plain USDC straight to the treasury. A free rat is minted by its seed (each seed once; its look is recomputed from the seed, nothing to store). An AI rat is minted with its job: the API stores its picture on Arweave (shrunk to a free upload, like the cats' pictures), keeps its 3D model itself, and signs the adoption, and each job is minted once. Nothing about a rat is secret: owners are public, unlike the boxes.

croquettes.rule: Each rat earns perDay plain CROQ a day, from its mint, claimed by its owner from the RatPantry. At most maxDays are kept between two claims: a rat left alone longer earns nothing more. The RatPantry is funded with `fund` CROQ by a plain transfer from the treasury (the deploy script sends them when its key holds them). While it is empty a claim reverts, so the days earned wait; when it runs low, claims pay what is left.

RatMinted.note: Rats. kind 0 is a seed rat (ref is the seed), 1 an AI rat (ref is the job id, uri its ar:// record).

Transfer.note: Rats. The standard ERC-721 transfer: owners are public.

RatsFed.note: RatPantry. CROQ paid to a rat's owner.
